contentText:
The Bosch Unlimited 10 offers a bendable tube so you can easily clean under furniture.

Bosch has announced it's releasing its first ever cordless stick vacuum in the US, the Bosch Unlimited 10 and 9. While Dyson tends to dominate the conversation in the US, Bosch has long been a major player in Europe, making its debut in the US cordless stick vacuum market a notable one.

Bosch says the vacuums are designed to pick up 99.99 percent of dust, even fine particles you can't easily see with the naked eye, and automatically adjusts power and performance based on the floor type.
